auditor_sam: Morning team — auditor here. For the Mar 14 incident I need a single-page control map for the SOC2 binder that proves: 1) RBAC remediation timeline (who/what/when), 2) KMS promotion + cryptographic linkage showing post-rotation ciphertexts reference the promoted version, 3) immutable snapshot of exported artifacts with sha256 and a signed manifest, and 4) vuln triage note that led to the fix. Please include exact S3 paths, short audit queries we can paste, and one short redacted CloudTrail + terraform snippet.

nell: We can produce that in one pack. High-level artifacts we will include: terraform-diff.txt (redacted), iam-events.json.gz, kms-events.jsonl, manifest.json and manifest.json.sig (GPG signed), bundle.tar.gz + bundle.tar.gz.sha256, triage.md, and deploy-log.txt.gz. Paths will live under s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/.

rachel: RBAC detail: rolebinding removal happened via terraform apply at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z by ops@redwood.com. Remote-state diff exported. Terraform snippet (redacted):
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svc_readonly" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
CloudTrail query (copy/paste):
```
filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime >= "2025-03-14T09:00:00Z" and eventTime <= "2025-03-14T09:10:00Z"
```
We exported matches to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/iam-events.json.gz (event ids preserved).

ell: KMS: we promoted the CMK alias/serving-cmk to version 12 at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt events include requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId which ends with ":12" for post-promotion writes. We also preserved x-amz-meta-kms-version:12 in object metadata for uploads after the promotion. Sample CloudTrail (redacted):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3c2d-1e0f:12" } }
```
Sample ciphertext envelope metadata captured on post-rotation upload:
```
-----CIPHERTEXT-ENVELOPE-----
x-amz-meta-kms-key-arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3c2d-1e0f
x-amz-meta-kms-version: 12
-----END ENVELOPE-----
```
Exported KMS events to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/kms-events.jsonl.

ops-bot: Auto-exported evidence:
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: 0a1b2c3d...)
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: 1b2c3d4e...)
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: 2c3d4e5f...)
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/manifest.json.sig (signed-by: ops@redwood.com, sha256: 3d4e5f6a...)
- s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/bundle.tar.gz and s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/bundle.tar.gz.sha256 (sha256: 4e5f6a7b...)
- WORM copy: s3://redwood-worm/6212345678/bundle.tar.gz (Object Lock Governance, retention-until: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z)
Presigned GETs (48h) created for auditor package.

nell: GPG/key: manifest.json.sig is signed by ops GPG key (fingerprint: D4A1 23BC 9F7E 0A12 3456 7890 ABCD EF12 3456 7890, key id 0x34567890). We'll include the ops public key link: https://keys.redwood.com/ops.gpg.

rachel: Vulnerability triage: triage.md attached — short summary: CVE-2025-7777 in base image redwood/serving:2.13; rated high; mitigation = rebuild base image (v2.13.1) and rolling restart completed 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6212345678/deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_sam: Two quick clarifications before I insert into the binder: 1) paste an exact terraform diff line + apply timestamp (you did) but make sure the snippet is copyable, 2) paste the single CloudTrail Encrypt entry (redacted) so I can paste into the control map.

rachel: Copyable terraform snippet (exact):
```
- resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "svc_readonly" {
-   role       = "svc-pod-readonly"
-   policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
- }
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
Copyable CloudTrail Encrypt event (exact):
```
{ eventTime: "2025-03-14T09:12:05Z", eventName: "Encrypt", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/9f8e7d6c-5b4a-3c2d-1e0f:12" } }
```

ell: Verification steps we'll publish in the control map: 1) gpg --keyserver keys.redwood.com --recv-keys 0x34567890; gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json, 2) sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256, 3) grep -F ":12" kms-events.jsonl to find Encrypt/ReEncrypt events referencing version 12, 4) match terraform-diff.txt apply timestamp to iam-events.json.gz eventTime values.

auditor_sam: Perfect. Please post the one-page control map here (plain text) with these fields: Control ID, Incident ID, Summary, Evidence list (paths + hashes), Audit queries (copy/paste), Retention & WORM, Crypto assertions (GPG fingerprint + KMS key ARN+version), Redactions, Owner contact. I will drop it in the binder.

auditor_sam: This is great — thanks. Please ensure presigned links are valid for 48 hours and that the ops GPG public key is available at keys.redwood.com/ops.gpg. I'll pull into the binder and follow verification steps. Leaving thread open for 24h for any minor edits.
